translation.name: Pwapwior we e Santus
translation.englishName: Satawalese: Pwapwior we e Santus (New Testament)

content: Toonongon Jesus Noan Jerusalem
Igiwe Jesus me rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun ra arap ngaeni Jerusalem, ra itto reen Bethphage reen rhugun Olives. Iwe nge Jesus a fangenoa riiurhai rhooan kkayeo kkewe
iwe a aengaeniir pwe, “Oawpwe noa noan pwugos mwu mmwaemi, nge oawpwe noa weri erhai donkey e feotaeg iginaan fengaen me minna naiun eno oaron. Oawpwe pwaeisiir nge oawwa wummwuur to reei.
Nge aere erhai epwe aepesa eew meeta ngaenigaemi, oawpwe aengaeni pwe, ‘Soamwoon e mwerhaen waawa’; ina rhag nge epwe fangenoa iir.”
A wen minneen pwe epwe pwaeri noa miniwe profeta e aepesa:

content.text: Emwaeri, a itto king we noawumw!
Etip sessoan nge e waawa erhai donkey,
erhai donkey mwittig, naiun erhai donkey.”

content: Iwe rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun ra noa feeori meeta miniwe Jesus a aengaeniir.
Ra pwigito donkey we me miniwe naiun donkey we, ra iseni tae mengaagiiur wooar, nge Jesus a teeotae wooan.
Iwe rhooa towunap we ra mmeraeg noa mengaagiiur wooan aan we, nge aaemweoi ra gopogop tiw paeiniu pwe enenaen wooan aan we.

Towunepeer aeremas kkewe regommw me mmwaen Jesus, pwan rhooawe re tapweto mwirin ra aekkepwas pwe, “Sipwe aepingepinga Naiun David! Deus epwe aewenepwuwa aeremas na epwe itto faaen itaen Soamwoon! Aepingepinga Deus na oarosaen taegias!”
Igiwe Jesus a toonong noan Jerusalem, oanongaen aepinoamw we ra riu pwurhopwurh fetaen reen. Ra aeiineo pwe, “Iyo mwaaeneei?”
Aaemweoi aeremas ra paniuwaeni pwe, “Iiy profeta we Jesus saengi Nazareth noan Galilee.”
Jesus a Noa Noan Temple we

Igiwe Jesus a toonong noan Temple we, nge a asiiur wow rhooawe re chuwaai me ameomeo pisaeg me igiwe. A aerheppa noa table kkewe aar rhooan ssiuwen senaapiy me nenien mooat kkewe aar rhooan chuwaai pigeons,
nge a aengaeniir pwe, “E foatofoat noan Pwapwior we e Santus pwe Deus a aepesa pwe, ‘Temple e aaei epwe ffai pwe imwaen maeipin,’ nge aaemi oawwa ssiuweniy ngaeni eew nenien wopoor rhooa mwoarho.”
Iwe rhooa kkewe re masparh me rhooa pirhemae ra itto reen Jesus noan Temple we, nge a aecchipwaar tae.

Nge soamwoonin patere kkewe me sinsein anniug kkewe ra igin soong reen min amwaraar kkewe Jesus a feeorin, me pwan aar wonigaet kkewe re iyaekkepwas me noan Temple we pwe, “Sipwe aepingepinga Naiun David!”

Iwe ra aeiineow Jesus pwe, “Wo rongorong minikka wonigaet kaan ra aepesa?” Jesus a paniuwaeniir pwe, “Ewaer, iya rongorong. Oawsaaen aeraegi mwo miniwe a foat noan Pwapwior we e Santus? ‘Aaemi oawwa oasuguunaar wonigaet me goagoa pwe repwe oassoara itoamw.’ ”
Iwe Jesus a nigitiir me Jerusalem, a noa ngaeni aepinoamwon Bethany. Iwe a noa no aegini epwoong igiwe.
Jesus a Soong Ngaeni Waniwan we Fig
Igiwe a sefaaeniti aepinoamw we noan soran we, nge Jesus a pecchai.

A weri waniwan we fig eno wenepeigin aan we iwe a faaeraeg ngaeni, nge a weri pwe esooar uwaan pwe rheon rhag. Iwe a aengaeni waniwan we pwe, “Esooar faaen eew ne wopwe rhiuwen uwa!” Noan rhag oaton we nge waniwan we a ppwass noa.
Igiwe rhooan kkayeo kkewe ra weri miniwe nge ra riutae nge ra iura pwe, “E ifa wusun rhag nge a noa mwetekkaein ppwass noa waniwan fig een?”

Jesus a paniuwaeniir pwe, “Ennetaen, ipwe aengaenigaemi pwe aere oaw niugiuniug, nge oawse tip mwaramwar, oawpwe mmwenen feeori meeta ngaang iya feeori ngaeni waniwan we fig. Nge saapw minneen rhag, pwe oawpwe pwan mmwenen aengaeni rhug een pwe, ‘Mwagiut saengi igeei nge wa noa oatoranoa oanongoamw nee metaw,’ nge epwe mmwen.
Aere oaw niugiuniug, nge oawpwe pwigi oanongaen meeta oaw tingoar noan aaemi maeipin.”
Kkepas Aeiineon Nemaeniaen Jesus

Igiwe Jesus a sefaaen nong noan Temple we, nge a fenai, nge soamwooniir patere kkewe me mwaaen kkewe aar ra itto reen nge ra aeiineow pwe, “Meeta nemaenioamw pwe wopwe feeori minikkeei? Iyo a ngaenneog oamw nemenem?”
Jesus a paniuwaeniir, “Ngaang ipwe aeiineogaemi eew kkepas aeiineo, nge aere oaw paniuwaeni, ngaang ipwe pwan aengaenigaemi iya iga i pwigi aaei nemenem me ee pwe ipwe feeori minikkeei.

Iya e itto aaen John nemenem pwe epwe paptismus fetaen: saengi Deus aere saengi aeremas?” Iwe, ra rhaepetae aar aengimaw fengaen wooar, “Meeta sipwe iura? Aere sipwe iura pwe, ‘Saengi Deus,’ nge iiy epwe aeiineogirh pwe, ‘Meeta rhag oawse niugiuniug ngaeni John reen?’
Nge aere sipwe iura pwe, ‘Saengi aeremas,’ si mesagiiur aeremas, pwe oanongeer re niugiuniug pwe John nge erhai profeta.”
Iwe ra paniuwaeni Jesus pwe, “Aeise giuneei.” Jesus a aengaeniir, “Iwe ngaang isoapw pwan aengaenigaemi iya iga i pwigi me ee nemaeniaei pwe ipwe feeori minikkeei.
Fioangoor Riiurhai Pwipwi
“Igina meeta aaemi niunniuwaen? Eno erhai mwaaen eyor riiurhai naiun mwaaen. A noa reen mwaaen we e tugufaeyi nge a aengaeni pwe, ‘Naeyi, wonoa engaang noan maetaen grape igina.’
Iwe nge iiy a paniuwaeni pwe, ‘Ngaang ise tipaeni ipwe noa.’ Nge mwirin a ssiuwen noa aan niunniuwaen nge a noa.
Iwe wonowe semeer a noa reen erhai naiun nge a noa aengaeni taeppen rhag iwe e aengaeni iwe erhai. Nge a paniuwaeni, ‘Ooa menap, ngaang ipwe noa,’ nge ese noa.

Iwe iyo neeiir rhooa ee riiurhai efeeori miniwe semeer e tipaeni?” Iwe, ra paniuwaeni, “Iwe e faeregit.” Iwe Jesus a aengaeniir, “Ennetaen, ipwe aengaenigaemi, pwe rhooawe rhooan iyoiyon tax me rhooapwutoi chuwaai kkewe nge repwe toonong noan Mweoiun Deus me mmwaemi.

Pwe John Baptist a itto reemi nge a pwaeri ngaenigaemi aan na e mwamwaai, nge aaemi oawse niugiuniug reen. Nge rhooawe rhooan iyoiyon tax me rhooapwutoi chuwaai kkewe ra niugiuniug reen. Inamwo iga oawwa weri minneen, nge aaemi oawse ssiuweniy aaemi niunniuwaen pwe oawpwe niugiuniug ngaeni.”
Fioangon Awewen Rhooan Aemmwenen Maat we

Iwe Jesus a iura pwe, “Oaw aiussaening ngaeni pwan eew fioangon awewe. A yor erhai mwaaen e foatogi eew maetaen grape, a feeori gurun niugiun, a genengi eew niipw pwe nenien wongowongin uwaen grape we nge a aiuwtae eew imwaen poos taegias me noan. Mwirin a ngaenneer aaemweoi rhooan maat pwe repwe aefaenniy. Iwe rhag nge a saei taaw noa.
Nge igiwe a toori oaton gin, a fangenoa naiun rhooan akkiuneo reer rhooan maat kkewe pwe repwe noa pwigito inetin me reen uwaen grape kkewe.
Iwe nge rhooan maat kkewe ra torofi rhooan akkiuneo kkewe nge ra wirhiy erhai, ra niiy noa erhai nge ra tera iwe erhai.
Mwirin nge mwaaen we a pwan fangenoa aaemweoi rhooan akkiuneo re towunap saengi rhooawe mmwan, nge rhooan maat kkewe ra pwan feeori ngaeniir wunuunun meeta kkewe ra feeori ngaeniir rhooawe regommw.
Oarosan nge a fangenoa mwaaen we naiun reer, nge a iura pwe, ‘I niugiuw nge repwe aesirowu mwaaen e naeyi.’

Nge igiwe rhooan maat kkewe ra weri miniwe naiun, ra aepesa fengaenniy nee fineer pwe, ‘Ieen mwaaen we naiun mwaaen we aan maat eei iwe epwe pwugusaeni minneei. Oaw itto sipwe niiy noa, pwe sipwe pwigi minne pwugusaen pwe pwugusarh!’
Iwe ra torofi, ra oatorawow me niugiun maat we nge ra niiy noa.”
Jesus a aeiineeor pwe, “Igina, ngaere mwaaen we aan maat we a war, meeta epwe feeori ngaeniir rhooan maat kkewe?”
Ra paniuwaeni pwe, “Epwe niir noa rhooawe re aenneew nge a ngaenneer aaemweoi maat we iyo kka repwe mmwenen fang inetin uwaen grape kkewe oaton gin.”
Iwe, Jesus a aengaeniir, “Oawsaaen pwan aeraegi mwo meeta kkewe Pwapwior we e Santus e aepesa?

content.text: ‘Fai we rhooan kaiu iimw re aerheei noa,
nge faer ina fai we egin yor ipitan me mmwaen oanongan.

content: “Iwe, ipwe aengaenigaemi, pwe minna Mweoiun Deus nge repwe pwigi saengigaemi pwe repwe ngaenneer aeremas kka epwe mmwen epwe feeori uuwan.
[Iyo a ppiungiutiw wooan faai een nge epwe mwetoarotoar noa, nge aere faai een epwe ppiungiutiw wooan erhai, epwe aepettatiw.]”
Igiwe soamwooniir patere kkewe me Pharisees ra rongorong fioangon awewe kkewe, nge re giuneei pwe e aepesaar,
iwe ra aegina pwe repwe torofi. Nge re mesagiu pwuwaen aeremas kkewe, pwe iir re iseni Jesus pwe erhai profeta.

footnotes.text: Petenan eei nge e soano noan aekkaew petenan kka e foatofoat noan kkepesaen Greek.
